references.label: Right return lane
references.description: The right-side lane that can add CHEESE progress.

references.label: Mouse Hole
references.description: The upper-right collect area reached through the right-ramp diverter.

references.label: MOUSE target bank
references.description: One of the two target banks that qualifies the physical Mouse Trap locks.

references.description: One of the two target banks that qualifies the physical Mouse Trap locks.

references.label: Left and right Mouse Traps
references.description: The two physical lock shots used to start Multiball and stage each jackpot.

references.label: Cheese / INCREASE target
references.description: The standup that starts 2x playfield scoring when INCREASE is lit.

references.label: Center 1-2-3 bank
references.description: The center targets that lower to expose the Million ramp.

references.label: Center Million ramp
references.description: The hidden center ramp used for kickback and MILLION progress.

references.label: Left orbit
references.description: The repeatable fallback loop when its right-flipper return stays controlled.
